message.content:
**Short answer:** Yes – you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise violations are handled by the city’s **Department of Public Safety (DPS)** and the **Atlanta Police Department (APD)**. You can do it online, by phone, or in person. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Method | What to do | Where to go / Who to call | |--------|------------|---------------------------| | **Online** | • Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website.
• Go to the “Noise Complaint” page (or “311” portal).
• Fill out the form with details (date, time, location, description, and any evidence).
• Submit. | (search “noise complaint” or “311”) | | **Phone** | • Call **311** (free, 24/7).
• Tell the operator you want to file a noise complaint. | 311 (or 404‑727‑3111) | | **In‑person** | • Visit the **Atlanta Police Department** or the **Department of Public Safety** office.
• Bring any documentation (photos, videos, witness statements). | APD Headquarters: 1000 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30309 | | **Mail** | • Send a written complaint to the DPS.
• Include all relevant details and any supporting evidence. | Department of Public Safety, 1000 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30309 | ### What Information Should You Provide? 1. **Date & Time** of the disturbance. 2. **Exact location** (street address or intersection). 3. **Description** of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). 4. **Duration** (how long it lasted). 5. **Any evidence** (audio/video recordings, photos). 6. **Your contact information** (optional but helpful for follow‑up). ### Typical Enforcement Process 1. **Initial Response** – APD may dispatch an officer to the scene. 2. **Investigation** – If the noise violates the city’s ordinance, the officer will document the violation. 3. **Citation** – The offender may receive a fine (usually $50–$200, depending on severity). 4. **Follow‑up** – If the noise continues, you can file a second complaint or request a code enforcement inspection. --- ## Atlanta Noise Ordinance (Key Points) - **Section 20‑1‑1** of the Atlanta Municipal Code governs noise. - **Allowed noise levels** vary by zone (residential, commercial, industrial). - **Prohibited activities** include: - Loud music or amplified sound after 10 p.m. (residential zones). - Construction noise outside permitted hours (usually 7 a.m.–7 p.m.). - Dogs barking more than 3 times per minute for over 15 minutes. - **Penalties**: Fines, mandatory noise‑control orders, and possible civil action. --- ## Quick Links - **City of Atlanta – Noise Complaint Form**: - **Atlanta Police Department – 311**: - **Department of Public Safety – Contact**: - **Atlanta Municipal Code – Noise Ordinance**: --- ### Tips for a Successful Complaint 1. **Be Specific** – Vague complaints (“loud music”) are harder to act on. 2. **Document** – Record the noise if possible; timestamps help. 3. **Follow Up** – If the noise persists after a citation, call 311 again. 4. **Know Your Rights** – If you’re a resident, you have the right to a quiet environment under the ordinance. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 system, the online portal, or visit the police department. Provide clear details and any evidence, and the city will investigate and enforce the noise ordinance.
